newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Jews sentenced for beating up rightist.
newsitem.headline: French Jews sentenced for beating up rightist.

text.p: Two members of a militant French Jewish group have been handed suspended prison terms and fines for beating up an extreme rightist on his way to a memorial mass for Vichy wartime collaborationist leader Philippe Petain.

Court sources on Friday said Michael Sultan, 22, and Anthony Attal, 20, members of the Betar youth movement, were each given month-long suspended jail terms and fined 2,000 francs ($360) on Thursday for attacking the rightist outside a church where the mass was held on May 1.
A statement from the Betar group said it regretted the court decision and warned: "Black days lie ahead for those who feel nostalgia for Nazism."
Petain was sentenced to death in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis, but the sentence was commuted to life imprisonment and he died in 1951.
